summary: F1 — Phishing mail from aegean-edu.co titled “Acil hesap doğrulaması” was delivered. F2 — An API-created inbox forward to d.yilmaz.payroll@gmail.com was observed. F3 — 38 SIS events occurred within 60 minutes from 185.220.101.7. F4 — Impossible travel from Amsterdam to Manisa in 234 minutes. F5 — Seven denied MFA pushes followed by one approval from 185.220.101.7. F6 — 47 sign-ins from BulwarkHost Ltd (NL) fell outside account baseline. F7 — Most sign-ins originate from NL (47 events). F8 — Password spray against 66 accounts from 193.140.10.44 preceded a successful login as this user.

risk.rationale: Confirmed account takeover chain: phishing lure (aegean-edu.co, F1) led to password-spray success as this user (F8), followed by MFA fatigue with a final approval (F5) from 185.220.101.7, then creation of an external inbox forwarding rule to d.yilmaz.payroll@gmail.com (F2) and 38 bulk SIS events within 60 minutes from the same IP (F3). Corroborated by suspicious/BulwarkHost NL sign-ins and impossible travel (F4/F6). All findings are verified LIKELY (0.7–0.9), with no rejected claims or data-quality conflicts. This matches T1566.002 → T1110.003/T1078 → T1621 → T1114.003 → T1213, i.e., a confirmed compromise requiring immediate containment.
